hints.title: Single Element Invariant
hints.text: At each step, 2 elements among the first 3 active elements are removed, leaving exactly 1 element behind.

hints.title: State Representation
hints.text: Define state (last, i) where last is the index of the single leftover element and i is the index of the next unprocessed pair.

hints.title: Three-Way Transition Choices
hints.text: There are 3 choices: remove (i, i+1) keeping last; remove (last, i) keeping i+1; remove (last, i+1) keeping i.

hints.title: Reference Implementation

complexity.notes: Memoized DP tracking the index of the single retained element and current position.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Simulating all permutations of removals explores O(3^(n/2)) branches.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Tracking only the retained element index collapses exponential subproblems into O(n^2).
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Identify the invariant that exactly one element is carried forward at each stage.
